[PREFERENCE] User is leaning towards the Godox V1 flash.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Comparison of Godox V1 and Sony HVL-F60RM in terms of build quality and durability:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Godox V1 has a plastic body, weighs 237g (8.4 oz), and has a minimalist design.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Sony HVL-F60RM has a full metal body, weighs 317g (11.2 oz), and has an ergonomic design.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Godox V1 is less robust than Sony HVL-F60RM but has a good track record for durability.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Sony HVL-F60RM is weather-sealed and built for heavy use.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Godox V1 has a longer battery life (up to 480 flashes) and faster recycle time (1.5 seconds) compared to F60RM (220 flashes, 2.5 seconds).  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Conclusion: Godox V1 is a good choice for affordability and performance; Sony HV
